summary.warning: These are unplaced shadow outcomes. The snapshot count overstates independent evidence because multiple handicap and kill-total entries came from the same evolving map.

moneyline.assessment: The pre-game GX edge was overstated. Blue side and draft structure did not compensate for SK's stronger lane and objective development.

killHandicap.assessment: Large positive cushions were robust while the compressed GX +3.5 failed. This reinforces line sensitivity and independent reassessment of each handicap move.

killTotalOver.assessment: The late Overs were supported by observed high kill velocity and completed damage items, unlike earlier draft-only kill-Over leans in other matches.

positiveFindings: Item-strength concentration improved the late read.
Observed fight velocity appropriately distinguished late kill Overs from draft-only Over speculation.
Large handicap cushions captured a close, volatile map better than the moneyline.
negativeFindings: Pre-game GX moneyline confidence was too high relative to roster uncertainty and lane matchup risk.
GX +3.5 was too compressed given SK soul-point and carry-strength concentration.
Repeated winning handicap snapshots must not be counted as independent model proof.
modelReview.operationalAdjustment: Prefer wide live kill-handicap cushions over marginal pre-game moneylines when map state is close but objective and item advantages create asymmetric win probability. Continue requiring independent reassessment as the cushion compresses.
